review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.fact: uniform -16px box.w across all card rows = classic scrollbar on velt-comment-dialog-threads-internal, not a sizing bug; fix the child overflow (overflow:hidden on the fixed-size icon box), never widen the rows
learnings.note: generalizes: icon nudges via margin OR transform both extend the scrollable overflow area; clip at the icon's fixed design box instead

learnings.fact: first-shot-css.mjs emits property-less rules (e.g. '{ 24px !important; }') when a connect-map entry nests state-keyed cssDecls objects (enabled/disabled); invalid CSS 500s the Next build
learnings.evidence: fam-sidebar-header build round 1; repaired in-place keeping values verbatim

learnings.fact: measure-block.mjs's report-assembly step does not forward --force, so a re-measure of a FINALIZED (STUCK) block updates artifacts but refuses the report entry; use report-block.mjs measure --force (sanctioned) and then block-iter record to restore the disposition

R29 --accept-glyph-residuals does not auto-accept a verified-identical glyph whose region fill exceeds the sparse threshold (0.103 > cap at 24x24); such residuals plateau the block — record STUCK with icon-lint identity evidence for human eyeball instead of pixel-nudging
learnings.evidence: stuck-evidence.md; the nudge attempt caused the scrollbar regression

learnings.fact: frame exports of component-state frames can carry content margins (card at 24,16) — frameRegion must be pixel-scanned/trued or the visual diff mis-aligns by the margin
scaffolded drive evals that seed comments must be passive/idempotent — a guard eval racing the async list double-submits on every measure
